summary: Located just moments from Hartlepool’s town centre, this well-presented two-bedroom mid-terrace property offers a perfect blend of comfort and convenience. For sale with tenant in situ with a gross yield of 10%.
description:
LOUNGE A good sized lounge featuring a central fireplace, offering a focal point for the room and a comfortable space for everyday living.

RECEPTION ROOM Additional reception room to the rear, with a window overlooking the yard and offering flexible space for dining or everyday use.

KITCHEN A practical compact kitchen located to the rear of the property, offering access and views to the yard.

BATHROOM A well appointed bathroom fitted with a bathtub, WC, and sink. The space offers practical layout and easy maintenance.

BEDROOM A spacious double bedroom located to the rear of the property, overlooking the yard and featuring built-in wardrobe storage for added convenience.

BEDROOM A generous second double bedroom situated to the front of the property, complete with built-in storage for added practicality.
